pilotRecords.title: Bi-26 grows with 2′-FL
pilotRecords.statement: Bi-26 grew with 2′-FL in culture; growth was lower than with lactose and higher than the no-added-carbohydrate control.
pilotRecords.model: Anaerobic culture in modified Bifidobacterium medium 58 at 37 °C
pilotRecords.dose: Not transcribed; consult Methods before quantitative reuse.
pilotRecords.endpoint: Culture growth (A600 and area under growth curve)
pilotRecords.sourceLocation: Results: Growth of B. longum subsp. infantis Bi-26 on 2′-FL, and lactose; Figure 2A–B; Methods: Growth conditions
pilotRecords.evidenceSummary: Growth curves distinguish substrate conditions in the tested strain.
pilotRecords.limitation: Culture growth is not evidence of infant clinical benefit or utilization by every B. infantis strain.
pilotRecords.nextAction: Check extraction against Figure 2 and add substrate concentration.

pilotRecords.title: Bi-26 fermentation yields metabolites
pilotRecords.statement: During 2′-FL fermentation, Bi-26 produced acetate, lactate, formate and 1,2-propanediol.
pilotRecords.dose: Not transcribed; consult Methods before quantitative reuse.
pilotRecords.evidenceSummary: The paper reports these products from metabolite analysis.
pilotRecords.limitation: This record does not establish an effect of those metabolites on host immune cells. It shares a study with E001 and is not independent replication.
pilotRecords.nextAction: Link each product to its results figure and a reviewed chemical identifier.

pilotRecords.title: A combined intervention changes MLN Th17 proportions
pilotRecords.statement: In germ-free mice, the BI + HMO group had a higher mesenteric-lymph-node Th17-cell proportion than the HMO-only group.
pilotRecords.exposure: B. infantis ATCC 15697 plus 2′-FL, LNT and 3′-SL
pilotRecords.comparator: Same HMO mixture without B. infantis
pilotRecords.duration: 14 days; bacterial gavage on days 1, 4 and 9
pilotRecords.dose: 5 mg/day of each HMO (15 mg/day total); 1 × 10^9 CFU per bacterial dosing day
pilotRecords.endpoint: MLN Th17 cells as a percentage of CD4+ T cells
pilotRecords.sourceLocation: PDF page 3: B. infantis shapes spleen and MLN immune cell composition; Figure 3; Figure 1 study design
pilotRecords.evidenceSummary: The result concerns a group comparison in a combined-intervention mouse experiment.
pilotRecords.limitation: 2′-FL was one of three HMOs. The comparison does not isolate a 2′-FL effect, establish a microbial mechanism, or show a clinical benefit in infants.
pilotRecords.nextAction: Verify Figure 3 and statistical contrast with a domain reviewer; retain the mixture and comparator.
